title: Unit Event — The Power of Regret

meta.Outline: Nene and her friends have made it to their final training destination, the Morinomiya Revue. While Nene goes into the experience excited to further grow as an actress, the boys' separate training and Emu's focus on business studies leave her attending practices on her own...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Look at this theatre...!
It's like a castle straight out of a fairytale...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow... So this is the Morinomiya Revue...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This theatre's so pretty!!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I wasn't expecting it to be quite so extravagant! Not only that, the path between here and the station was designed in the same manner...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose we should expect nothing less from the Morinomiya Revue, since it's been around for over a hundred years.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. The all-female Suzurangumi is so popular that even people overseas talk about them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But recently, the all-male Kikyogumi has started to gain some traction as well. Getting to train here really is a huge honor...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Indeed!
We'll need to thank Emu's brothers again later for winning us this opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh...?
You're standing as straight as an arrow, Nene! Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... But I am feeling pretty nervous.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Morinomiya is like a dream stage for people who dream of becoming musical actors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Very true.
Their grand and refined shows are captivating to not just the viewing public, but also actors all over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Precisely! The pinnacle of musical excellence in Japan! Quite a few former Morinomiya members have gone on to become famous actors!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we can't leave out the part about their practices being really hard...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, they are famous for pushing their actors to the absolute limit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Which is why I think we need to be prepared mentally.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm not just feeling nervous right now. I mean...)

Excuse me.
You're Wonderlands×Showtime, yes?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...!
Y-Yes, that's us!

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line:
It's wonderful to finally meet you.
My name is Arita. I'm a member of the production team here at the Morinomiya Revue.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: I'll be your guide today, so I'll be happy to explain everything as needed. For now, I'm very much looking forward to working with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes!
We also look forward to working with you!!

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: First, let me show you around our facilities. Please, come this way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I have to say, this place is astounding...!
The theatre is one thing, but this rehearsal room is enormous!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm also surprised by how much equipment this place has available. I suppose I shouldn't expect anything less from a highly successful enterprise.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I wanna learn as much as I can about how they run things around here!

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: Hehe. Your brothers indicated that to us a little while back, so we went ahead and created a special position for you.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: During your time here, you'll mostly be involved in the operational side of things.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: Anyway, this concludes my tour. From here, I'll be explaining more about how you'll be practicing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: But there's something I need to mention to all of you first.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: I regret to inform that you will not be practicing with any members of this revue during your time here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: We agreed to give you all this opportunity after seeing everything you've all done at Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: Unfortunately, outside of publicity events, non-affiliated parties are not allowed to observe our rehearsals. This is a mandate from management.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: So, during this visit, you'll all be training with the Morinomiya Music Academy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?! We get to take lessons at the Morinomiya Music Academy?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, I've heard of that school!
It's where everyone studies to become members of the Morinomiya Revue, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's right.
Several hundred apply to enroll each year, but they're competing for around thirty spots.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Only those who are accepted can apply to become members of the Morinomiya Revue. In other words, they're the best of the best.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: Also, practices at the academy are also divided based on gender.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: So, Mr. Tenma, Mr. Kamishiro, you'll be participating in the all-boys practices.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: And you in the all-girls practices, Ms. Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm doing operations, Tsukasa and Rui are with the boys, and Nene's with the girls... Doesn't that mean we're all gonna be separated?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it does.
This is a little different from what we're used to, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Understood...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I am a little worried about being separated from the others.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But getting to train at the Morinomiya Music Academy is a huge opportunity for us. I'm really looking forward to this experience...!
The next day
Morinomiya Music Academy
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, Ms. Kusanagi, this is the class you'll be working with starting today for the next three months.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Beyond this door are Morinomiya's students...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The chosen few who've gathered from all over Japan. Their acting and singing skills must surely be incredible.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I don't have time to be scared.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Because I'm also going to keep growing as an actress!!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Anyway, Ms. Kusanagi, shall we enter?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes!
Morinomiya Music Academy - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Good morning, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Whoa...
They're all bowing at the same exact angle.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This feels more like a professional sports team than a musical troupe. I guess they do have it pretty hard here...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And I have to do my best to keep up with them.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
This is Nene Kusanagi.
She will be studying at Morinomiya with all of you for the next three months.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: She still has to attend her regular school like normal, so she won't be here all day during the week. But she will be here from start to finish otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: If you don't mind introducing yourself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
My name is Nene Kusanagi!
I'm a member of a troupe called Wonderlands×Showtime, and will be studying to improve my acting skills here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to working with all of you starting today!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you as well!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Studying here means that you'll be treated the same as any other Morinomiya student, Ms. Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: So, everyone, if she has any questions regarding the rules and expectations we place on our students, please help her out.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Anyway, that concludes our morning meeting. Let's do our best again today to uphold the name of Morinomiya.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Phew...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That was a little nerve-wracking, but I'm glad I was able to introduce myself to everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I have to stay focused.
I need to do my best in order to learn new acting techniques and other ways to express myself using my body...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... I'm starting with a ballet lesson. The classroom for it should be...
se_walk_women_005_3
se_walk_women_005_2
Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yes?!
Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: My name's Imura! I'm really looking forward to working with you! Things might be a little hard at first since the rules here are so strict, but feel free to ask me any questions!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: Nice to meet you. I'm Mori.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: Come to think of it, have you already received today's schedule? You're going to need it, so I can have a copy made if you don't have one.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, I just received a copy a minute ago.
But thank you for offering.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The people in this class are a lot nicer than I was expecting...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hesitated for a second there, since this place is so famous for being strict. But I guess my worries were misplaced.)
Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes, how can I...?
...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Whoa...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This person has perfect posture.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Her core seems incredibly strong.
It's like she's ready to perform at a moment's notice.)
Forgive me for doing this just before our lesson, but I felt that I should introduce myself to our new addition.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
My name is Byakkomachi.
I'm the head of this class.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
The head...?
Like a class president?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes, that's essentially my job.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: As the head of our class, Byakkomachi sits at the top of the pyramid.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: Many who enroll in this school are already talented singers and dancers in their own right.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: But Byakkomachi here stands head and shoulders above the rest of us. The executives and staff can't seem to get enough of her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
Umm... I feel honored to be speaking with somebody in your position.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Haha. You're going to make me blush.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: In any case, as the head of this class and your fellow classmate, I plan on giving you all the support I can.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'll show you around the changing and recreations rooms once our lesson is finished.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me. It's all a part of the job. Oh, look at the time. Our lesson is about to start...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right!
Um, how should I start preparing or warming up?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: First, let's use the mirror... Oh, before that.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: You're not officially enrolled here and you're only here for a limited time, but you will be treated the same as the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Simultaneously, you'll be expected to act and produce results all on your own.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Things aren't going to be easy.
But I hope that you'll still do your best.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes!
I understand!

rows.Speaker: Ballet Teacher
rows.Line: When you perform a grand jeté, maintain control all the way down to your fingertips! You will not be able to dance with grace unless you have control over every part of your body!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Even after all that training we did with Mikazukigumi...
My legs feel like jelly already just from ballet basics...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But the others haven't stopped dancing for a second... Just how much stamina do they have...?!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, I can't let them leave me behind.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to keep going, no matter how hard any lesson gets!)

rows.Speaker: Ballet Teacher
rows.Line:
That should be enough for today.
This lesson is adjourned.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff...! Huff...! Huff...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can finally catch my breath...)

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
That was incredible, Kusanagi!
It's only your first day, but you managed to keep up!

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line:
I agree!
I remember being completely exhausted during my first day.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: Please try to stay hydrated, since these practices are likely going to feel extra difficult while you try to get used to things around here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you! I'll be careful!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Excuse me, ma'am.
Do you have a little time right now?

rows.Speaker: Ballet Teacher
rows.Line: How can I help you, Ms. Byakkomachi?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Could I ask you to look over how I dance from the middle through the finale? I still feel like I'm missing something...

rows.Speaker: Ballet Teacher
rows.Line:
But your form is near perfect.
It seems unnecessary to push yourself any harder...

rows.Speaker: Ballet Teacher
rows.Line:
Alright, fine...
Show me. But only just this once.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you!
se_event_regret_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's so elegant...

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line:
She really is...
Even after that lesson, she doesn't look tired at all.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: I know, right? I guess this is what it means to possess world-class talent.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: World-class?

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Yeah, she's so good that world-famous directors have been coming to visit our school in addition to seeing our shows. For example, Jack Howard, the creator of “Spirit”...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: And he isn't alone. All sorts of people have been trying to recruit her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
Yes, really!
You won't believe how many people have already asked her to audition for their troupes and companies!

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: But despite all that, she chose to enroll at Morinomiya! Because she loves this place so much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's clear that she has the talent to become a world-class performer. That's obvious just based on her aura and how refined her movements are...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I'm going to do the same, I have to become as good as her at the very least.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll have to do my best during our next lesson...!

rows.Speaker: Voice Teacher
rows.Line: Next, I'd like for you all to sing one at a time. We'll start with the front row at this end.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Now we're having a singing lesson.
Everyone's good...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this is my chance to do well...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is my wheelhouse, so I need to show everyone what I've got!)

rows.Speaker: Voice Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, next.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Her voice is so beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you. That's it from me...

rows.Speaker: Voice Teacher
rows.Line:
Oh, pardon me. Thank you.
Please take a seat.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She hesitated there for a second. Does that mean I didn't do well? I thought I did okay...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, I don't have time for that right now. I need to stay focused on this lesson.)

rows.Speaker: Voice Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, that concludes today's lesson.
You'd like to tell them about it now, yes?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, so...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: As I'm sure you all already know, auditions for our next quarterly performance will be held soon.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Quarterly performance? Auditions?
This is news to me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Also, what happened...?
Why do things feel so tense now all of a sudden?)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The title of this performance will be announced tomorrow during your acting lesson. Please let us know if you know that you will not be present.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Also, Ms. Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We will be expecting you to audition for this performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Ms. Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, no. If anything, I really appreciate you setting aside the time to do this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to explain how the auditions for your quarterly performances work.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm more than happy to, since you just arrived here. So, to explain...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We hold regular performances once every three months, but they're meant to only be seen by those at this school.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The goal is to get everyone used to performing on stage. In other words, to give our students experience.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Also, during the day of, everyone will get to see the other classes perform and take notes on their star actors.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Our voice teacher asked to have you audition after hearing the way you sing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I'm told you sounded incredible during your lesson just now. You're good even by Morinomiya's standards.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Thus, the other teachers and I believe that the other students will benefit from you participating.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...!
Really? Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Hehe. I hope you do well.
However...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Only those who are chosen will be allowed to perform on stage.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Which is why everyone is always doing their best... They'll be preparing for these auditions like their lives depend on it, so you'll need to do the same, Ms. Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Understood.
I promise to do my best...!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Wonderful! I'll be expecting good results.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Like their lives depend on it, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That explains why things felt so tense back there.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I have to do my best...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to capitalize on this opportunity if I want to keep growing!)
Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'll be auditioning for their next quarterly performance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...! That's great, Nene!
You get to audition for one of their shows already?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, auditioning sounds like fun!
I wish I could compete for a role!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Competing against everyone sounds like a lot of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I'm not sure “fun” is the word I'd use, based on how the others reacted...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm so jealous!!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I wanted to compete for a role...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Morinomiya Music Academy's auditions are supposed to be extremely challenging! You stand to learn so much just by participating...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We heard that the all-boys class also holds regular performances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, due to the timing being different, we won't be able to audition for anything.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! That's terrible...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Terrible is an understatement... Especially since auditions like these shine a spotlight on areas which need improving...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that is true...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Remember how much you improved when we did “The Happy Phoenix”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Exactly! Ordeals such as these are great learning experiences in disguise! So, not being allowed to participate is beyond unfortunate...
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: In other words, auditions are a golden opportunity to improve as a performer...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, this is a huge chance for Nene to improve as a singer and actress!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Precisely!
As sad as I am about not being able to participate, we should give Nene all the support she deserves!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right. We gotta cheer her on like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Here we go, Nene, here we go!
We believe in you, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I'll even send some of my star power your way when you go to audition!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'll also give you lots of support!
By...! Uhh...! Sending you my smile power!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too♪
Here's my break-a-leg audition power!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I'll send some of my director power♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not necessary...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, thanks, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They're definitely right about this audition being a huge opportunity.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I'm gonna grow as an actress, then I have to throw everything I have at it!)
The next day
Morinomiya Music Academy - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Okay, let's start discussing our next quarterly performance.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
It's titled “Luca”.
And it was written just for this performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They write stories just for these performances? But only the people at Morinomiya get to see them... Wow.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I'll pass out the scripts now, so please take this time to flip through them quickly.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: And don't forget to think about which roles you'd like to try auditioning for.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(“Luca”...
I wonder what it's about.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Interesting...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The protagonist, Luca Roussel, is a kind boy from a family of nobles.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He falls in love with the princess he meets in the rose garden, and he decides to try to become a suitable partner for her.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(However, it's also a period of civil unrest...
In order to quell the rebellious masses, he becomes more cunning and tyrannical.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Before he knows it, his cruel ways have resulted in the lives of tens of thousands being brutally cut short.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (In time, he becomes the youngest person in the history of the military to be named a deputy commander, which reunites him with the princess.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (However, she ends his reign of terror by cutting him down on the eve of a major suppression campaign.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Then, she weeps as she says, “I fell in love with the boy I met back in that garden. I didn't want to see your hands become even more stained in blood!!”)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's so sad...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But it also makes for a good story...
It's certainly dramatic, with the future of the country at stake.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Are you free to talk for a bit, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Byakkomachi, hi!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: If you'd like, I can take a minute to explain how these auditions work.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I haven't really been told anything yet. Thank you very much for taking the time to help me like this.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Hehe. There's no need to be so formal.
We're fellow classmates now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Then, I'll begin by explaining how these auditions will be run.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Their format is a bit unique compared to elsewhere. Over the course of two weeks, those who don't have what it takes will be cut along the way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Cut...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: In the beginning, everyone will be auditioning for their top choices.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: However, because multiple people will be vying for each role, we have to take turns performing individual scenes in front of the teachers.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: However, they can ask for the next person to go if at any point they feel that something is wrong.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Well, in the event they go through every candidate, they start over again with the first person.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
The teachers are difficult to please.
They'll stop you the second you show any doubt.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: At the end of each day, those who have been judged to lack what it takes will be barred from auditioning further.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, after that happens, what are those people supposed to do?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Audition for a different role.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: If you want to stand on that stage, then you have no choice but to try for something else like your life depends on it. In other words, your flexibility is also being observed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Which role do you plan on auditioning for, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My plan is to audition for Luca.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what I like to hear.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Luca's tricky, since you need to have very good singing and acting skills to do him justice. But playing him should also be a rewarding experience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes, I'm going for the same role.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I won't be pulling any punches, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If Byakkomachi is going to audition for Luca, then things definitely aren't going to be easy...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I want to try playing a male character.
And I should go for Luca if I am serious about growing as an actress.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I need to try my absolute best to win...!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Now, we'll be doing a read-through.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We'll be holding rehearsal-style auditions starting tomorrow, so please have your lines memorized by then.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Understood!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There was so much tension in the air during that read-through. Things got competitive when we were with Shunmeiza and Mikazukigumi, but not to this level....)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to be careful not to get overwhelmed.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're free to do whatever we want after this, so I might see if any of the others want to practice as a group. That should make it easier for me to learn my character.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Line: Oh, she's...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_run_women_005_1

rows.Line: Then, I'll try asking someone else...

rows.Line:
You're wrong.
Luca wouldn't get so emotional during this scene.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Uh oh...)

rows.Line: (Things are getting pretty heated over there...)

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Hey, stop it...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Stop what?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
I was not.
We may be vying for the same role, but that doesn't give you the right to make any baseless accusations.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: If anything, my guess is that you came to spy on me practicing. You even copied me during the last audition.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
What...?!
I just happened to land on the same interpretation as you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Calm down, you two.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: We don't have much time to practice, so you shouldn't be spending any of it arguing.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I don't know if she did actually try to peek at your notes.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But I do know that this isn't how you should be using your time.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The same thing happened last time. While you two bickered, your competitors learned to play their characters better.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Also, even if you did somehow manage to win a role by spying on someone, the teachers will find out sooner or later.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
So, let's all use our time productively.
Anyway, I'll see you all later.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I don't understand...
This atmosphere... Everyone's acting like...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Nothing like this happened when we auditioned with the other troupes...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I knew that things would be tough at Morinomiya.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But...
To think that the dazzling shows I'm used to seeing are born out of this sort of environment...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No...!
The kind of environment I've been tossed into doesn't matter!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've never auditioned for a character like Luca before. Not only is he challenging to play, there's fierce competition.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which is why I'm sure to grow if I do somehow manage to win the role.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, for the sake of my dream, I have to do absolutely everything in my power to play him!)
The next day
Morinomiya Music Academy - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, beginning today, we will be holding auditions for “Luca”.

rows.Line: Understood!
se_walk_women_005_4

rows.Line:
This is it, Kusanagi.
Let's both do our best.

rows.Line: Yes, let's...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Seven, eight... Nine people.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My portrayal of Luca has to be better than all of theirs, or I'll lose my chance...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to perform like my life depends on it...!)

rows.Line: We'll start from the top, to the parting in the rose garden. Rehearsal format.

rows.Line: So, the Luca in this scene will be played by Ms. Byakkomachi. And you'll be playing Princess Louise, Ms. Komiyama.

rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I thought they all did really well, but they've all been getting pulled. This is rough.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As for Luca...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: “Pardon me!”

rows.Line: “Could... Could I ask your name?”

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
“Oh...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
“Luca Roussel...

rows.Line: She really is good...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Byakkomachi's providing such a natural depiction of his nervousness and anxiety.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: “Louise...”

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: “I see... Your name is Louise...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's capturing Luca's pure spirit really well.)

rows.Line:

Let's move to the next scene.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The next Luca will be... Ms. Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:

I have to do everything I can to match up against her acting!)

The next day

rows.Speaker: Luca Candidate A
rows.Line:
“Ah, Louise!
For you, I am willing to do anything. My life is yours!”

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Next!

rows.Speaker: Luca Candidate B
rows.Line: “We must not leave a single rebel standing...!”

rows.Line: Next!

rows.Line: (The air feels so heavy...)

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Is that all?

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Uhh... I mean...

rows.Speaker: Teacher

We cannot allow someone with such a shallow understanding of her character to play the lead.

se_run_women_005_1
se_run_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Teacher

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is rough...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:

We've finished cleaning the rehearsal room, so I just have to go over what I was told today, and...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? There's a notebook on the ground.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, it's Imura's...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But she just...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
We cannot allow someone with such a shallow understanding of her character to play the lead.

se_run_women_005_1
se_run_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
*Nod*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, do you mean this one?

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Thanks, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... If you have time, would you like to go to the school store together? It's hard not to feel hungry after a tough practice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(She looks really sad...
Her eyes are all red...)

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: No, sorry... Not today...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow...
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No...! W-Wait, Imura!

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I, uhh...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I actually really liked your portrayal of Luca...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, umm... During tomorrow's lesson—

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Stop it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Imura

se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What...? Pity...?
I was just trying to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's true, I did feel like I needed to say something...)
<Nene...? Is everything okay?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Len...
Morinomiya Music Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, you saw everything?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
Sorry, I didn't mean to peek.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I'm actually glad you're here. I'm having trouble digesting what happened.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I do think I was in the wrong back there.

rows.Line: I didn't actually take Imura's feelings into consideration.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ever since coming here, I feel like my emotions have been all over the place...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I've been telling myself to do my absolute best in order to keep growing as an actress...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But everyone here...
They're all competing too hard against each other...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, they seem to have no trouble ignoring anyone in need or pain.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know that auditions can be tough, but this feels...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I know what you mean.
You're supposed to be putting on this show together, so it feels bad that things are like this...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But, is that really...>
Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Byakkomachi!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Are you by yourself?
I thought I heard someone else's voice just now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, no... I'm alone.
Anyway, is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I just ran into Imura.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I noticed her crying, so I decided to ask how she was doing. Then, she replied, “I said something really terrible to Kusanagi just now.”

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: She wants to apologize to you, but she's having trouble getting her thoughts together. So, I offered to relay her message to you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you, Byakkomachi.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But there is something I need to tell you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: You still seem to be misunderstanding something.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you mean...? Misunderstanding...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I imagine that you tried to cheer up Imura because you and her are both chasing after the same dream.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: However, no one here at Morinomiya thinks like that.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Rather, we actively refuse to think like that.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Everyone here is striving to make their dream come true by becoming the best performer ever.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Because we all know that, we have no trouble throwing everything we have at each other when push comes to shove.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
There is no room for pity.
Rather...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Showing pity to your opponent would be inappropriate. This is a serious competition.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: If you have the time to feel bad, then you have time to further polish your acting. If you succeed where others have failed, you owe them that much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Right. I'm here to...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: If you disagree with that philosophy, then it would be best if you left this place immediately.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: That's all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Nene...? Are you feeling okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think I finally understand, after what Byakkomachi told me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I realize now that I wasn't fully committing myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I came in intending to grow as an actress. But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I framed it as taking the experience they could give me, and learning what they had to teach me. Deep down, I approached it passively...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wasn't resolved to fight for and win this role like my life depended on it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Which is why I kept hesitating...
I kept looking around at others...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But no one here at Morinomiya thinks that way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They're throwing absolutely everything they have at each other in order to become the best actors they can. In order to win.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Nene...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I think your kindness and how you look out for those around you are really wonderful, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But when push really comes to shove, I think there's something you have to prioritize more.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'm glad I get that now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'm done looking around at everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm going to stand up straight and meet everyone else head-on.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah. Break a leg!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When I set out into the world, I'm probably gonna find myself clashing with others in much the same way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'm diving in head first...!!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: (In this scene, Luca's...)

rows.Line: (His words sound gallant, but he's definitely feeling a complex mix of emotions.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Ah... Louise!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*

rows.Line:

rows.Line: This is the scene that heralds Luca's descent into tyranny.

rows.Line: It's vital to convey to the audience that the timid boy has taken the first step on a path that ends with him as a complete monster. But how best to do that...

rows.Line: Right...

rows.Line: Oh, what if I used my eyes more...?

rows.Line: Singing while on my side is really hard, so I need to find a solid position and...

rows.Line:

My voice is going to sound funny if act too emotional.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, I know...
I can try that thing Ms. Kazamatsuri taught me.
Final day of auditioning
Morinomiya Music Academy - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, this is the final day of auditioning.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We'll be deciding final roles today. Keep that understanding in mind as you perform.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Our remaining candidates will be performing the scenes which we have chosen. We will not be stopping you this time. You will be expected to play the scene out to the end.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The scenes we have chosen are...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
For the protagonist, Luca, page 78.
From the moment Louise stabs him until the final song.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Next, for Princess Louise, the scene starting on page 35...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I knew it...
They picked the final scene for this day.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (By this point, Luca has no qualms with harming the citizenry, and the story reaches its climax when his beloved Louise stops him.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (In terms of this show, it's the biggest test of one's singing and acting skills...!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Now then, we have five candidates vying for the role of Luca. To prevent any variance due to different co-actors, you will each act opposite the same Louise.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
You will be performing in this order...
Ms. Osawa, Ms. Ito, Ms. Kanae, Ms. Kusanagi and Ms. Byakkomachi to finish.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Time is of the essence, so let us get started.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(This is it.
Our final audition...!)

rows.Speaker: Luca Candidate A
rows.Line:
“Louise...
I just...”

rows.Speaker: Luca Candidate A
rows.Line: “Wanted to be by your side...”

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: And scene.

rows.Speaker: Luca Candidate A
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Everyone's been really good.
They've all improved so much since the first day.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(And this atmosphere...
There's so much tension in this room that I feel like it could burst at any moment.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They're all serious about this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's as though their lives depend on whether or not they get this role.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Next, Ms. Kusanagi, please get ready.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Understood!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm just as serious about this!!)
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Luca in this scene feels so proud as he enters the rose garden...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Because he believes he's finally worthy to be with his beloved.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So he comes in, unable to fully hide the happiness he feels...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Having completely forgotten about the thousands of lives he's cut down.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Hello, Louise.
It's been quite a while since we last met here.”

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line:
“Luca...
Yes, it's been years...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Five, if I'm not mistaken.
Back then, I used to cry like a baby whenever I pricked my finger on one of these roses' thorns.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “But I've changed, Louise.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Now, it doesn't matter if I get hit by a rock thrown by a rioter, or a spear tip cuts my cheek. I won't cry a single tear.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Because now, I am a knight. Your knight.”

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line: “Luca...”

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (Kusanagi's doing well so far.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (But here is where things get difficult...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (Because this is the moment Louise uses Luca's heart as a sheath.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (This sudden turn of events causes him to experience a violent mix of confusion, anger and horror... And love. She has to grapple with, and express, this torrent of emotions...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to seeing how you play this part.)

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line: “Look at this rose, Luca...”

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line: “Remember what I told you all those years ago? About how I always wanted to see a blue rose?”

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line: “I feel that this rose has a slightly blue hue to it.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Huh? Really?”

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line: “Yes... But you surely can't tell from all the way over there. Join me over here...”

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line: “Come close to me now, and...”
se_walk_women_005_2

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Wait... You...!”

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
(She's good...
I was under the impression that she still struggled with nuanced physical acting.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (But the way she froze after realizing what just happened, as well as the way she's moving her hands... You can clearly see the impact of the blade, and how much pain Luca is in right now.)
se_walk_women_005_3
se_walk_women_005_3
se_walk_women_005_2
se_walk_women_005_2

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Louise...?”

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line:
“I'm so sorry, Luca!
But...”

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line: “I had to do this...! I didn't want to see your hands become even more stained in blood!!”

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line: “You once said that you wanted to become the groundskeeper for this rose garden. You said that you didn't mind being pricked by the thorns...!”

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line: “That was the boy I fell in love with...!!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “What are you saying...?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Wait, that means...
Everything I've done until now...!”

rows.Speaker: Louise
rows.Line: “Luca!!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “H-Haha...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “It was all for naught...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “All the innocent people I rounded up and butchered. All the children I mercilessly had sent to the gallows.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“All of it... Everything I did...
It just made me drift further away from you...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Why didn't I take the time to examine your feelings closer...?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I simply wanted to be close to you...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Louise...
Promise to remember this one thing...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Louise...
I just... Wanted to be by your side...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I wanted to sit here with you... To gaze at a blue rose... And express our joy in song...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Don't cry, Louise...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Please, smile...
For you are the most beautiful rose... In the entire world...”

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
(I see...
So this is what she went with...!)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (This is the song they sang together in the rose garden when they were little. It makes this story just that much more tragic, since this is where they must part.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (The others all sang like Luca was taking his final few breaths. However...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (Kusanagi is focusing on his love for Louise.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (Luca sings with gentle warmth, because he doesn't want to see her cry.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (He'd become a monster in the pursuit of his goal, but this shows the audience that there truly was love there...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: (That love adds an extra layer of depth to this tragedy, simply because it's so pure.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Bravo...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: And scene. That'll do, Ms. Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
Thank you very much!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was so nervous, but I managed to perform the way I practiced...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I actually managed to give it absolutely everything I had!!)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Alright, I'm up next...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I really have to thank you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Because now I feel like I can put on the best rendition of Luca I ever have.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: “Don't cry, Louise...”

rows.Line:
“Please, smile...

rows.Line: (But I know I did everything I absolutely could.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (On top of Emu and the others helping me a ton, I used everything that Ms. Kazamatsuri taught me to build and polish my role.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (All I can do is believe in myself...!)

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Ms. Byakkomachi.

rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I guess that's only natural.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Byakkomachi was obviously amazing, but so were all the others.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Outside of the parts that involved singing, I wasn't really able to stand up to them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is really frustrating...)

rows.Line:
(I did everything I could...
And I still wasn't enough...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Now I understand...)

rows.Line: (This is how Imura must've felt that time...)

se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Byakkomachi...
Do you have a second?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Kusanagi...
Yes, how can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wanted to congratulate you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Your Luca was staggering.
Break a leg for the actual performance, too.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, that's all...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Wait.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I also need to thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The others certainly pushed me to do better, but you in particular gave me the most motivation.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Your acting and singing were both spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: From the moment you began singing until the second Luca took his last breath, you made it clear just how much he loved Louise.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I regretted not seeing it myself...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But what you did also made me want to surpass you.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Faced with your performance, I felt I had to win at all costs.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: In other words, your singing lit a fire in me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My singing led to Byakkomachi's performance...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh...
Now I see...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is what it really means to push each other to become better.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (You win, you lose, you feel this regret and use it to hone your craft and yourself.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's how you really move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's what it means for everyone here to walk the same path together.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I need to compete more, myself.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(In order to keep growing.
In order to get closer to making my dream come true.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to face them head-on, and better myself, just like I did this time.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm beyond frustrated... And I really regret not being chosen for Luca...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I also know where I am as an actress now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Now I genuinely want to become better.
I want to keep moving forward, even if I have to compete to do it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'm really glad that I had a chance to audition for this role.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to being blown away by your show, Byakkomachi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I promise to do my best backstage.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'll make it a performance worthy of the effort you put in, too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Still, Kusanagi, you and I are really alike...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I was stunned by your transformation.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: You have a powerful desire to become a great actress who puts on incredible performances on stage. The same desire as me...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'm glad that someone like you decided to come train with us. So, let's keep pushing each other to become better.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Absolutely!!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Since we're talking, would it be possible for you to tell me more about Wonderlands×Showtime?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'm really interested in learning more about what your troupe is like now. Would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'm standing here right now because the others helped me get to this point...
